query:
SELECT
            u.birth_date,
            u.gender,
            b.weight::float8 AS "weight_kg?",
            b.height::float8 AS "height_cm?"
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT weight, height FROM body_snaps WHERE user_id = u.id ORDER BY rec_ts DESC LIMIT 1
        ) b ON TRUE
        WHERE u.id = $1
